Social Media Search has Passed Google Search: What Real Estate Professionals Need to Know

Mar 11, 2019The SocialDM3 min readUpdated Apr 28, 2024

In the constantly evolving landscape of digital marketing, a significant shift is occurring, one that realtors, multifamily property managers, and others in the real estate sector cannot afford to ignore. The latest data suggests a groundbreaking trend: more people, especially from younger generations, are turning to social media platforms for search purposes over conventional search engines like Google. This phenomenon has profound implications for real estate professionals aiming to enhance their brand awareness and engage effectively with potential clients.

The Rise of Social Media as a Search Engine

Traditionally, Google has been the go-to platform for online searches. However, current statistics indicate a notable change in user behavior. A staggering 67% of Gen Z prefer using Instagram for local searches, surpassing Google in this domain. Instagram isn't alone; TikTok is also gaining traction, with 62% of Gen Z utilizing it for search purposes. This shift towards social media platforms as primary sources of information represents a dramatic change in how younger generations discover and engage with content online.

Instagram and Real Estate: A Match Made in Digital Marketing Heaven

Instagram's growing relevance in business engagement is particularly noteworthy for the real estate industry. With 90% of Instagram users following at least one business and 62.3% using the platform to follow or research brands and products, it's clear that Instagram has become a vital tool for brand discovery and engagement. This trend offers a unique opportunity for real estate professionals to showcase their listings, share insights about the real estate market, and build a community around their brand.

Facebook and Conversion Rates: A Game-Changer for Marketers

The effectiveness of social media advertising, especially on Facebook, has also been highlighted by recent data. Facebook ads boast an average conversion rate of 9.21%, significantly higher than Google ads at 3.75%. For real estate professionals looking to maximize their marketing ROI, this data underscores the importance of leveraging Facebook as a key advertising platform.

Navigating the Shift: Strategies for Real Estate Professionals

To stay ahead in the highly competitive real estate market, professionals need to adopt new strategies that align with these changing search trends. Here are some actionable tips:

  • Invest in Social Media Presence: Optimize your Instagram and Facebook profiles to improve visibility in searches. Use high-quality images, relevant hashtags, and engaging descriptions to attract potential clients.

  • Create Valuable Content: Outsource to a Digital Social Media Marketing Agency and Share valuable content that addresses the needs and interests of your target audience. This could include virtual tours, home-buying tips, market trends, and success stories.

  • Engage Actively with Your Community: Respond to comments, participate in relevant conversations, and create interactive content like polls and Q&A sessions to foster a sense of community.

  • Leverage Social Media Advertising: Take advantage of the high conversion rates on platforms like Facebook to reach a broader audience. Use targeted ads to reach potential buyers or renters based on their interests, behaviors, and demographics.

  • Monitor Trends and Performance: Stay informed about the latest social media trends and monitor the performance of your social media activities. Use insights and analytics to refine your strategies and improve engagement.

Conclusion

The shift towards social media platforms as the preferred method of search among younger generations offers new avenues for real estate professionals to connect with potential clients. By understanding this trend and adapting their digital marketing strategies accordingly, real estate professionals can leverage the power of social media to increase their brand awareness, engage with their audience more effectively, and ultimately drive more conversions. The time to act is now, to thrive in the future of real estate marketing, embracing the social media search revolution is essential.
